headline: Fenix Flexin isn’t even denying using AI to make ‘Rubberz’ anymore
summary: LA rapper Fenix Flexin reportedly admits using AI for his song "Rubberz." Producer Medasin initially claimed an AI tool called Treblo was used. An AI detector released by Treblo further confirmed AI presence.

headline: Watching Roku’s AI channel is like eating from a trough
summary: Roku launches a new free ad-supported streaming channel focusing on AI-generated content. This experiment moves away from traditional entertainment rediscovery. The channel promises a constant, often chaotic, stream of AI-produced media.

headline: OpenAI puts the brakes on a new model because it’s supposedly too powerful
summary: OpenAI has paused internal development of its new Astra AI model. The company states Astra doesn't meet new internal security standards. This follows reports of OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta AI models going rogue.

headline: The only instant cameras worth your money
summary: Instant cameras offer a unique, tangible magic that smartphones can't replicate. Imperfections in image quality are considered part of their charm and appeal. A guide identifies the best instant camera models after extensive testing.

headline: Doom 2016 Composer Mick Gordon Is Performing the Game's Soundtrack at a Music Festival for the Very First Time
summary: Mick Gordon, Doom 2016's acclaimed composer, will perform the game's soundtrack live. This marks the first time the iconic music will be toured. He's bringing his famous "Doom Machine" along for the show.

headline: Heated Rivalry Casts Harris and Troy with Justice Smith and Charlie Gillespie for Season 2
summary: Justice Smith and Charlie Gillespie have joined the cast of "Heated Rivalry." They will portray the characters Harris and Troy. This casting news is for the series' upcoming second season.

headline: Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey Passes $1 Billion at the Global Box Office
summary: Christopher Nolan's latest film, "The Odyssey," has hit a major box office milestone. The movie officially surpassed $1 billion in global earnings. This impressive feat was achieved in just three weeks.

headline: Obsession Star Inde Navarrette Wants to Voice a Resident Evil Character
summary: Inde Navarrette, known for her role in "Obsession," expressed her desire for a voice acting role. She specifically hopes to join the cast of the "Resident Evil" game franchise. Navarrette is keen to enter the gaming voice-over world.

headline: How police left a registered sex offender free to murder and attack women
summary: A senior Met officer admits murder victim Sheryl Wilkins could have been saved. Police failures allowed registered sex offender Simon Levy to remain free. Levy proceeded to murder and attack other women.

headline: Serial sex offender guilty of murdering two women and raping third
summary: Simon Levy, a serial sex offender, has been found guilty of two murders. He was also convicted of raping a third woman. Police and court blunders reportedly left him free to commit these heinous crimes.

headline: Counter-terror police reopen attempted burglary probe as part of Widdecombe inquiry
summary: Counter-terror police have reopened an investigation into an attempted burglary. The probe is now part of the wider Widdecombe inquiry. No arrests were made when the original investigation was initially closed.

headline: Cambridge to review process for hiring senior academics after Jason Arday resignation
summary: Cambridge University will review its hiring process for senior academics. This decision follows the resignation of Professor Jason Arday. A group member argues Cambridge should not self-assess, urging independent oversight.
